Class AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.models.AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel
Direct Known Subclasses:
KeyDisplayValueSwingModel, SimpleComboListSwingModel
public abstract class AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel extends Object
This class encapsulates the list and list data used for SwingSet list and combobox components. The class holds a reference to a List<ListItem> and it's method createListItem(java.lang.Object...) is a factory that creates ListItem objects. It does not have public methods to modify the list; getRemodel and sub-classes provide that. Using install(javax.swing.JComponent, dev.visdb.seesaw.models.AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel, javax.swing.ListCellRenderer) a proxy that delegates to this class is installed into a JList or JComboBox.

Where possible, this class and subclasses name methods similarly to the List interface, such as "add*", "remove*".

The encapsulated data can be thought of as a two dimensional array [ height X width ]; the height is the size of List<ListItem>, the width is the number of elements in a ListItem . The number of elements in an ListItem is controlled by a property, see setItemNumElems(int); the property may only be changed when the item list is empty.

createElementSlice creates live, read-only, lists of the individual elements of an ListItem; it is [ height X 1 ]. This live list track changes to the main list. The slice always has the same number of items as the main list.

The contents of an ListItem are read through the protected AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.ListItem0 interface. The contents are modified through methods in this class.

This class is not parameterized; all ListItem elements are Objects. It is expected that sub-classes are parameterized and cast as needed.

Remodel

Inspections and modifications of the item list, and of its SSListItems, are done through a Remodel Object see getRemodel(). The remodel object is "try with resource" compatible and subclasses may implement locking in their implementations of takeWriteLock() and releaseWriteLock(). See GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo for an example.

Compatible with GlazedLists AutoComplete feature; in which case an EventList is set in the constructor. See GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo usage in SSDBCombox for use Glazed AutoComplete feature

Since:
4.0.0

    • AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel

      protected AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel(int itemNumElems, List<ListItem> itemList)
      Construct a info container; if the specified itemList is null an array list is created. Only use this constructor directly if you are sure you must.

      If an itemList is passed in, lose the reference; if the list, or its contents, are modified directly then swing model events are lost.

      Parameters:
      itemNumElems - number of elements in an ListItem
      itemList - list to manage, may be null

    • install

      public static void install(JComponent jc, AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel model)
      Creates and installs a ListCellRenderer into the JComponent. The new renderer uses getListItemFormat() to get the value to render. The renderer is either a DefaultListCellRenderer or a BasicComboBoxRenderer as appropriate.

      The model is installed into the JComponent as a convenience.

      Parameters:
      jc - Jcomponent to set up with model; must be JList or JComboBox
      model - associated model

    • createElementSlice

      protected <T> List<T> createElementSlice(int elemIndex)
      Create a list slice of the item list. There is no checking on the element index.

      If a returned element slice is not valid according to the itemNumElems property, setItemNumElems(int), then an attempt to use that slice causes an exception. An element slice becomes valid/invalid dynamically as itemNumElems changes.

      Type Parameters:
      T - list type
      Parameters:
      elemIndex - position in ListItem of elements
      Returns:
      list of elements at the specified position

    • hasShadow

      public boolean hasShadow(List<?> list)
      Determine if the argument list is a slice of this item list. A slice is a live list of an SSListItem element; it is backed by an item list.

      Note that if the list is a slice from a different item list, then false is returned.

      Parameters:
      list - check this list
      Returns:
      true if the specified list is backed by this

    • remodelTakeWriteLock

      protected void remodelTakeWriteLock(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel remodel)
      Track the depth of taken reentrent lock, and adjust remodel.isClosed. This is invoked during Remodel construction, be careful. If a sub-class has real locking, the lock should be taken before super... call to here. This method is responsible for incrementing countOpens Other than that, if there is no locking then implement an empty method
      Parameters:
      remodel - if null, then manual take

    • remodelReleaseWriteLock

      protected void remodelReleaseWriteLock(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel remodel)
      Track the depth of taken reentrent lock, and adjust remodel.isClosed. This is invoked during Remodel close.

      This method is responsible for decrementing countOpens remodel.isClosed = true to prevent re-use

      Parameters:
      remodel - if null, then manual release

    • getRemodel

      protected abstract AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.Remodel getRemodel()
      This returns a Remodel which has method for reading and writing the itemList and its contained listItems.

      This is typically used in a try with resources 

          class ListInfo extends XxxListInfo {...}

    try (ListInfo.Remodel remodel = listInfo.getRemodel()) {
    	// examine and modify the list info
    	if (!remodel.isEmpty()) { ... }
    	else { ... }
    }
      Returns:
      a Remodel permit
